name: Jeremoth
overview: Jeremoth is a male descendant of Mushi, belonging to the tribe of Levi. He is identified specifically as one of the Mushites, who are descendants of Merari, a son of Levi. This lineage situates Jeremoth within the Levitical family, known for their priestly and temple-related duties in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremoth means 'height' and is a proper name not given directly by God. Another form of the name, Jerimoth, means 'swollen or obese,' also a proper name without divine origin. These variations reflect common Hebrew naming practices but do not indicate any special title or role beyond his Levitical heritage.
familyAndRelationships: Jeremoth is explicitly recorded as a descendant of Mushi, linking him to the family of Merari, son of Levi. Scripture does not provide additional family relationships for Jeremoth beyond this genealogical connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremoth's significance lies in his identification within the Levitical genealogy, emphasizing the continuity of the priestly line through the Mushites. His mention in 1 Chronicles highlights the detailed record-keeping of Israel's tribal and family structures, which is essential for understanding the organization of temple service and worship. Though not a prominent figure in narrative events, Jeremoth represents the faithful transmission of Levitical heritage important for the worship and service of God.
